menu_paper_doll.configuration.title: Menu Paper Doll Configuration
menu_paper_doll.configuration.offsetX.to: Moves the paper doll left or right, in percent of the screen width. Negative is left, positive is right.
menu_paper_doll.configuration.offsetY.to: Moves the paper doll up or down, in percent of the screen height. Negative is up, positive is down.
menu_paper_doll.configuration.scalePerce: Calculated as a percentage of the screen size; the default size is one third of the screen height.
menu_paper_doll.configuration.followMode: How the paper doll follows the mouse cursor.
menu_paper_doll.configuration.showDragon: Draw the wings from Dragon Wings: Rebuild behind the paper doll. Only shown when that mod is installed.
